# 词典 M

## 概述

本页收录以字母 M 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设补充词汇、常用短语、易混淆词辨析与学习提示，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇      | 词性  | 含义             | 常见搭配             | 例句                                                             |
| --------- | ----- | ---------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| milestone | n.    | 里程碑；重要节点 | reach a milestone    | We reached a major milestone by completing the beta release.     |
| mentor    | n./v. | 导师；指导       | mentor new employees | She mentors new employees during their first three months.       |
| margin    | n.    | 利润率；边距     | profit margin        | The profit margin increased by 5% compared to last year.         |
| mandate   | n./v. | 授权；强制要求   | government mandate   | The new mandate requires all teams to adopt CI/CD pipelines.     |
| mediator  | n.    | 调解人；中间人   | act as mediator      | The project manager acted as mediator between the two teams.     |
| matrix    | n.    | 矩阵；组织架构   | matrix organization  | In a matrix organization, employees report to multiple managers. |
| monetary  | adj.  | 货币的；金融的   | monetary policy      | The monetary incentive attracted more senior candidates.         |
| morale    | n.    | 士气；精神面貌   | boost morale         | Team-building activities help boost morale during crunch time.   |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇       | 词性 | 含义               | 常见搭配             | 例句                                                               |
| ---------- | ---- | ------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| mundane    | adj. | 平凡的；日常的     | mundane tasks        | Automating mundane tasks frees up time for creative work.          |
| momentum   | n.   | 势头；动力         | gain momentum        | The open-source project gained momentum after the conference talk. |
| mingle     | v.   | 交际；混合         | mingle with others   | The networking event was a great chance to mingle with peers.      |
| meticulous | adj. | 一丝不苟的         | meticulous attention | She has meticulous attention to detail in her code reviews.        |
| modest     | adj. | 谦虚的；适度的     | modest improvement   | We saw a modest improvement in page load times.                    |
| memorable  | adj. | 难忘的；值得纪念的 | memorable experience | The hackathon was a truly memorable experience for everyone.       |
| mindful    | adj. | 留心的；注意的     | mindful of deadlines | Be mindful of the upcoming deadline for the proposal.              |
| monotonous | adj. | 单调的；乏味的     | monotonous routine   | A monotonous routine can lead to burnout over time.                |

## 技术相关

| 词汇         | 词性  | 含义             | 常见搭配                  | 例句                                                                  |
| ------------ | ----- | ---------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| middleware   | n.    | 中间件           | authentication middleware | The authentication middleware validates tokens on each request.       |
| microservice | n.    | 微服务           | microservice architecture | We broke the monolith into a microservice architecture.               |
| merge        | v./n. | 合并             | merge a branch            | Please merge the feature branch after the code review is approved.    |
| migration    | n.    | 迁移；数据库迁移 | database migration        | Run the database migration before deploying the new version.          |
| module       | n.    | 模块             | import a module           | Each module handles a single responsibility in the system.            |
| mock         | v./n. | 模拟；Mock 对象  | mock the API              | We mock the API responses in our unit tests.                          |
| mutex        | n.    | 互斥锁           | acquire a mutex           | The thread must acquire a mutex before accessing shared resources.    |
| memory leak  | n.    | 内存泄漏         | detect memory leaks       | The profiler detected several memory leaks in the background service. |
| monorepo     | n.    | 单一代码仓库     | manage a monorepo         | We use a monorepo to manage all our frontend packages together.       |

## 补充词汇

| 词汇          | 词性 | 含义               | 常见搭配               | 例句                                                            |
| ------------- | ---- | ------------------ | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| mandatory     | adj. | 强制的；必须的     | mandatory training     | Attendance at the security training is mandatory for all staff. |
| miscellaneous | adj. | 杂项的；各种各样的 | miscellaneous expenses | File the receipt under miscellaneous expenses.                  |
| meticulous    | adj. | 细致的；精确的     | meticulous work        | His meticulous work on the documentation saved the team hours.  |
| multitask     | v.   | 多任务处理         | ability to multitask   | The role requires the ability to multitask under pressure.      |
| monopoly      | n.   | 垄断；独占         | market monopoly        | The company holds a near monopoly in the search engine market.  |

## 常用短语

| 短语              | 含义           | 例句                                                                          |
| ----------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| make sense        | 有道理；说得通 | Does the proposed architecture make sense for our scale?                      |
| move forward      | 推进；继续     | Let's move forward with the approved design.                                  |
| meet the deadline | 赶上截止日期   | We worked overtime to meet the deadline for the client.                       |
| map out           | 规划；制定     | We need to map out the project timeline before the kickoff.                   |
| miss the mark     | 未达预期       | The initial prototype missed the mark on user experience.                     |
| move the needle   | 产生显著影响   | This feature should move the needle on user retention.                        |
| mark my words     | 记住我的话     | Mark my words, this technology will reshape the industry.                     |
| make do with      | 凑合着用       | We'll have to make do with the current hardware until the budget is approved. |

## 易混淆词辨析

| 词组                     | 区别说明                                               |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| moral vs. morale         | moral 指"道德的"，morale 指"士气"，拼写和含义均不同。  |
| mandatory vs. compulsory | 两者都表示"强制的"，mandatory 更常用于商务和法律语境。 |
| memorize vs. remember    | memorize 强调"刻意背诵"，remember 强调"自然记住"。     |

## 学习提示

- **milestone** 在项目管理中高频出现，Jira 等工具中常设置里程碑来跟踪进度。
- **microservice** 和 **middleware** 是后端架构面试的核心词汇。
- **merge** 是 Git 工作流的基本操作，与 rebase 一起构成分支管理的两大策略。
- **monorepo** 是大型前端项目的流行管理方式，Nx 和 Turborepo 是常用工具。
- **move the needle** 是商务汇报中描述重大影响的地道表达。
- **meticulous** 是推荐信和绩效评语中描述工作态度的高频形容词。
